stanza_to_reference_map.caption_text_exact: King Nandagopan went to the kingdom of Mathura to pay taxes where Kamsa is ruling,. Vasudeva met Nadagopan and talked affectionately and very friendly to him.
stanza_to_reference_map.visual_mapping_reason: Nanda travels to Mathura and meets Vasudeva.

stanza_to_reference_map.caption_text_exact: Vasudeva congratulated Nandagopan and expressed his happiness over him on the birth of a son and conveyed that he is as happy as he would have got one.
stanza_to_reference_map.visual_mapping_reason: Vasudeva congratulates Nanda on Krishna’s birth.

stanza_to_reference_map.caption_text_exact: Vasudeva warned Nandagopan of the bad omens which are felt at Gokulam at that time and hence instructed him to return home back as quickly as possible. Hearing it, Nandagopan was apprehended and took his way to Gokulam.
stanza_to_reference_map.visual_mapping_reason: Vasudeva warns Nanda to return quickly because of bad omens.

stanza_to_reference_map.caption_text_exact: In the meanwhile, Putana, the demoness, under Kamsa's order visited Nandagopan's house in the disguise of a beautiful woman, with hair adorned with beautiful and attractive flowers.
stanza_to_reference_map.visual_mapping_reason: Putana arrives at Nanda’s household in disguise.

stanza_to_reference_map.caption_text_exact: Putana, who killed several infants, lifted Krishna in her hand. The other Gopikas wondered amongst themselves as to who this beautiful lady was.
stanza_to_reference_map.visual_mapping_reason: Putana takes Krishna while the gopis watch.

stanza_to_reference_map.caption_text_exact: Awestruck by her charming looks, Gopikas did not obstruct her when she took the child in her hand. She chose a place in the house and started to feed the child with her breast milk.
stanza_to_reference_map.visual_mapping_reason: Putana begins nursing Krishna in the house.

stanza_to_reference_map.caption_text_exact: Angered at Putana's killing of innocent children, Krishna fearlessly climbed on to her body and sucked the poison smeared breasts as if it was a huge mango fruit.
stanza_to_reference_map.visual_mapping_reason: Putana’s alarmed face with Krishna at her breast conveys the fatal nursing episode; the intimate framing does not show the full act, but caption and sequence establish it.

stanza_to_reference_map.caption_text_exact: Krishna sucked the life of Putana, acting as if he was sucking the milk. She fell on the ground making thunderous sound with both hands stretched, reverting to her huge demoness form.
stanza_to_reference_map.visual_mapping_reason: Putana’s body falls in giant demoness form as villagers approach.

stanza_to_reference_map.caption_text_exact: Hearing the huge sound, entire Gokulam was in a state of shock. Seeing Krishna playing innocently on the dead body of Putana, Gopikas came and picked him up hurriedly.
stanza_to_reference_map.visual_mapping_reason: Gokula villagers gather at the fallen body while Krishna is recovered.

stanza_to_reference_map.caption_text_exact: Gopikas prayed to Bhagwan, chanting his various names which brings auspiciousness to the world, seeking him to protect the child without knowing that Bhagwan only is in the form of child Krishna in their hands.
stanza_to_reference_map.visual_mapping_reason: Gopis surround and ritually bathe/protect the child, consistent with their protective naming/prayer.
